player_prompt.intro:
Ove uva Muthandi {player_id} mu Connect Four.
Ombolola ya nguo ya diski yove: {symbol}.
Tavule ya michezo ina {num_rows} milalo na {num_cols} mikoloni.
Muthandi unuha unuha kwa mpito, kwa kuweka diski yake mu mikoloni (0 kuenda {end_col}).
Uwa wa kwanza kuhangana (mikwamo yake) diski nne kwa unda, kwa mukoloni, kwa diagonal, ove uwinu.
Pa mpito yove, tanga nambari ya koloni mu vitu vya miraba, ili uende.
Kwa mfano: '[col 4]' kana '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Ombaunda ya kambutele haijulikani kwa ovikele.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Mfumo wa kufanya kambutele si sahihi. Mfumo unaojaribuwa: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Kambutele si sahihi. Kamba {col} iko nje ya mipaka.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Kambutele si sahihi. Kamba {col} imejaa.

action.dropped_disk: Player {player_id} adropola kambutele yake ({player_symbol}) mu kamba {col}.

outcome.draw: Omapalo yaco ya sulila lika vekango.
